newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers flat to down, sellers keen to trade.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers flat to down, sellers keen to trade.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were unchanged to softer on Tuesday amid reasonable demand totalling 15,000 tonnes, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst was unchanged from Monday at $88 a tonne, with 180 cst a touch softer at $93/94. MDO at both Rotterdam and Antwerp was at about $153 and gas oil was slightly down at $165/170.
Brokers said bunker sellers were keen to do business and prices were softening as a result, while high sulphur barges traded slightly weaker.

In Hamburg, trade was hectic as dealers competed with Rotterdam. "There is too much product and too few enquiries, so we are having to push owners in our direction against Rotterdam," one trader said.
Hamburg 380 cst was down about $2 at $90-93, with 180 cst at $97-102.
Trade at Fos and Augusta was quiet, with prices slightly down from Monday.
Augusta 380 cst was at $95, 180 was at $102 and gas oil was at $106 plus transport costs, dealers said.
